name: GLM-5.4
archDisplay: Loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base model for two iterations ("750B scale"); exact parameter counts undisclosed; 1M-token context, 128K max output; text, image, video and file in
note: Z.ai's November 23, 2026 release, available at launch on the GLM Coding Plan, ZCode and Z.ai Chat; the API is listed as coming soon, and Z.ai plans to open-source the weights after safety hardening, so openness stays closed. It loops 28 layers of the GLM-5 base for two iterations at "750B scale" and serves up to 200 tokens/s off-peak. Z.ai's model docs give a 1M context and 128K max output with video, image, text and file input. No price yet (the pricing page still ends at GLM-5.3), and no benchmark score in text: the blog's win-rate and 30B ablation charts are images, so no rows are filed.
